title: AIAS Charter and Executable Architecture Handbook
purpose: Complete the missing institutional foundations with a canonical Charter and machine-verifiable architecture rules aligned to the Constitution and SDD.
scope: Mission, identity, values, authority, professional boundaries, architectural layers, dependency rules, public contracts, modularity, reversibility, evidence and contradiction validation.

requirements.title: Canonical Charter
requirements.statement: The system shall define why AIAS exists, its mission, scope, values, stakeholders, authority and professional boundaries.
requirements.rationale: Close the first missing foundational document.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Architecture Handbook
requirements.statement: The system shall define executable layers, dependency direction, contracts, modularity, reversibility and integration rules.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Hierarchy
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce Charter, Constitution, SDD, Handbook, program specification and generated-artifact authority order.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Architecture validation
requirements.statement: The system shall reject forbidden inward/outward dependencies and missing public contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Professional boundary
requirements.statement: The foundations shall preserve legal, jurisdictional and licensed-professional responsibility.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible release
requirements.statement: The system shall provide CLI, tests, documentation, installer, manifests and checksum-protected release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
